project.name: The Forest
project.objective: Build a persistent, measurable, recursively optimized autonomous production system that advances through canonical state and executable continuation.

warrant.objective: Reconcile the larger Forest product stack against existing canonical and experimental structures without prematurely promoting provisional ontology.
warrant.selection_reason: Runtime verification gate passed; highest-leverage next step is reconciling the full product architecture so later UI, world-model, memory, agent, and reality-interface work share one coherent map.
inputs: existing substrate, memory-ecology, and ai-mycelium artifacts

quality.completion_claim_policy: No completion without ledger evidence and explicit verification. Completion of one phase must not be conflated with completion of Forest as a whole.
quality.known_verification_gap: The runtime kernel is repository-verified with 25 passing tests. The whole-product architecture map is provisional sketchpad material and has not yet passed canonical reconciliation/promotion gates.

permissions.external_execution: must be explicitly configured by runtime operator/environment

decisions.decision: Keep executor injection replaceable rather than hard-code a single agent/provider into the kernel.
Retries require an explicit recovery policy and are bounded by max_retries.
Regenerate the next production warrant from canonical task state after each persisted continuation pass rather than hand-maintaining duplicate control state.
Prefer compact continuation observations plus deterministic gap derivation over duplicating dashboard state as a second source of truth.
Validate canonical state before execution and again after telemetry and warrant regeneration but before persistence; invalid durable state must not silently advance.
Passing the runtime verification ledger closes the runtime-kernel phase only; the production ledger must extend into the next Forest growth phase rather than returning global DONE.

history.summary: Established repository-resident canonical runtime state after persistence, bounded recovery, and CLI control surface were implemented.
Implemented a portable subprocess executor with bounded observable failure results and automatic production-warrant regeneration; advanced the ledger from 5/10 to 7/10 criteria implemented.
Implemented reconstructable continuation telemetry and deterministic gap scanning, integrated observation before persistence, and advanced the ledger to 8/10 criteria implemented.

Implemented JSON Schema enforcement at runtime boundaries, added validation regression tests, and advanced the implementation ledger to 9/10 while preserving end-to-end execution as an explicit verification gate.
First repository-native CI run failed because pytest was not installed; failure preserved as evidence rather than counted as verification.
Declared test dependencies, repaired traceback-unsafe validation exceptions, aligned runner fixtures with canonical schema, and achieved 25/25 passing runtime tests in GitHub Actions.
Closed the verified runtime-kernel phase and opened whole-product architecture reconciliation using a provisional sketchpad map rather than falsely declaring Forest complete.
